extDescription.message: Auto ChatGPT for your prompts at scale. Batch generate and auto-download responses and images on ChatGPT.com.

modeHint_text.message: Generate a text reply for every prompt in the queue.

modeHint_textToImage.message: Generate images from text descriptions. Every generated image is downloaded.

modeHint_imageToImage.message: Send each prompt together with a source image to transform or enhance it.

modeHint_ingredients.message: Send reference images along with each prompt and collect the text replies.

concatHint.message: Keep all prompts in one conversation so each builds on the previous reply. A combined file is saved at the end.

chainHint.message: Use the image generated by the previous prompt as the input for the next one.

autoMatchHint.message: Only attach images whose file name appears in the prompt (e.g. "alice.png" for a prompt mentioning Alice). Off = attach all.

promptsPlaceholder.message:
One prompt per line…

Or separate multi-line prompts with a blank line.

promptsHint.message: One prompt per line. If the text contains blank lines, each block becomes one prompt.

newChatOnStart.message: Start a new chat when the run starts

keepPanelOpen.message: Keep this panel open while the queue runs. You must be logged in to chatgpt.com.

queueEmpty.message: No prompts yet. Add some above.

samplePrompt.message: a cozy cabin in the snow

confirmClear.message: Remove every prompt from the queue?

logFailed.message: Prompt #{0} failed: {1} — giving up after {2} attempt(s).

singleChatHint.message: All prompts of the queue go into one ChatGPT conversation. If the run is interrupted, the extension returns to that chat and continues where it stopped.

logRefused.message: Prompt #{0} was refused by ChatGPT — retrying ({1}/{2}).

logRefusedSkip.message: Prompt #{0} was refused by ChatGPT — skipped, moving to the next prompt.

logResumed.message: Prompt #{0} was already sent before the interruption — collected its reply without resending.

logSessionLost.message: The session chat could not be opened — continuing in a new chat.

logNewSession.message: The next run will start a new session chat.

logTimings.message: Prompt #{0}: chat ready in {1}s, reply in {2}s.
